tools.name: corsizio_get_account
tools.description: Get the Corsizio account behind the API key: name, alias, time zone, currency, site URL, contact, and the configured locations, categories, age groups, genders, levels and price ranges (their ids are the filters for corsizio_list_events). Good first call. API: GET /account.

tools.name: corsizio_list_events
tools.description: List the account's events (classes, workshops, camps) with dates, location, prices and page URLs, newest start first by default. Only published events unless status says otherwise. Filter by status, date range, price range, category/location/age/gender/level id (from corsizio_get_account) or a name

tools.name: corsizio_get_event
tools.description: Get one event in full: dates, location, ticket prices and early-bird prices, descriptions, max spots, contact and instructors. Use include=stats for registration counts. For the attendee list use corsizio_list_attendees with the event id (or corsizio_get_event_with_attendees). API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: corsizio_get_event_with_attendees
tools.description: Get one event together with its attendees (and optionally each attendee's payment) in a single call. Returns personal data of registrants (names, emails, phones, notes); only use it when you need the roster, otherwise prefer corsizio_get_event or corsizio_list_attendees with a limit. API: GET /event

tools.name: corsizio_list_attendees
tools.description: List attendee registrations across the account, or for one event (event filter): name, email, phone, status, registration answers and dates. Default status is active. Filter by status (e.g. owing,!canceled), created-date range, event id, coupon code or a search word (name, email, phone). Returns per

tools.name: corsizio_get_attendee
tools.description: Get one attendee registration in full: contact data, registration answers, internal remark, status, and with include=payment the amount, fees, taxes, refunds and transactions (card brand and last 4 digits). Returns personal data. The API key needs the attendees permission. API: GET /attendees/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: corsizio_get_account, corsizio_list_events, corsizio_get_event, corsizio_get_event_with_attendees, corsizio_list_attendees · Private data: corsizio_get_account, corsizio_get_event, corsizio_list_attendees, corsizio_get_attendee · Public sink: corsizio_list_attendees.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: corsizio_get_account, corsizio_list_events, corsizio_get_event, corsizio_get_event_with_attendees, corsizio_list_attendees · Private data: corsizio_get_account, corsizio_get_event, corsizio_list_attendees, corsizio_get_attendee · Public sink: corsizio_list_attendees

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
